answer: Each identity locks 70, filing a sealed hash of claim and nonce at the forge. A violet seal binds the hash to one key; one claim under two keys burns both bonds. At reveal it publishes claim and nonce; the registry rehashes, burns duplicates or late reveals, and logs each on the ember tally. First reveal 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented reveals lack fresh nonce. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep it.
